headline: Fuel Prices: Schlein Says Price Cap Has Collapsed Like Every Lie by Meloni
summary: Opposition leader Elly Schlein said Italy's fuel price cap has collapsed. She urged the government to activate mobile excise duties and tax energy companies' windfall profits.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into Italian inflation, household spending and the margins of refiners and fuel retailers.
